summary:
Lion Shipbrokers Weekly Market Report - Week 40 (03 OCTOBER 2025)
**Broker**: Lion Shipbrokers Limited (Athens, Greece)
**Issue Date**: 2025-10-03 | **Report Week**: Week 40, 2025

Quote of the Week
> "When mooncakes are shared, business takes a break."
>
> - **Chinese proverb**

Tankers
Europeans are splashing the cash ($472 million) in four VLCC resales (Tier 3, scrubber
fitted) from Hengli Dalian Shipyard, with deliveries scheduled for 2026. Bulkers
Our Chinese friends are currently away for Golden Week (October 1st-8th), celebrating the
Mid-Autumn Festival with traditional mooncakes and lanterns. With multiple holidays across the Far
East - including South Korea (October 3rd-9th) - the s+p market has a quieter feel (and
significantly fewer emails!).
